result_preview.description: This data product synthesizes campaign execution data, customer account hierarchies, and segment-level behavioral metrics to provide comprehensive ROI tracking and attribution analysis. It summarizes key performance indicators across campaigns, customer segments, and account relationships to enable data-driven marketing optimization and segment profitability assessment. The product delivers actionable insights on campaign effectiveness, segment engagement patterns, and return metrics by customer account.
